facts.fact: 梦里有被静态裹住的男性轮廓观察她，她听得到低沉声音念她名字；她不害怕，反而认得这声音。
facts.anchor: He’s cloaked in static; a silhouette of white noise that shifts and buzzes in a way that reminds me of reception on an old television.

facts.fact: 每天早晨夜柜上准时出现一朵干压花，今天的是黑大丽花；她不知道花怎么进来的——公寓在六楼顶层、门和窗都上三重锁。
facts.anchor: Each morning, without fail, a new one waits on my nightstand. Dried and pressed flat.

facts.fact: 她把干花收进前租客留下的玻璃罐，舍不得扔；她觉得留花的人懂她——她要的不是鲜艳鲜花，而是「已活完使命之物的安静尊严」。
facts.anchor: They feel too precious to throw away. It’s a peculiar thrill to know that whoever leaves them understands exactly what I prefer: not the garish quality of fresh blooms but the quiet dignity of things that have already lived their purpose.

facts.fact: 蒙特利尔是她八年里的第九个城市；18 岁被最后一个寄养家庭赶走，档案里全是「太安静、太疏离、无法亲近、太想自杀」的转手理由。
facts.anchor: Montréal marks my ninth city in eight years.

facts.fact: 她在新工作做应收账款，选这份工作图的是人际接触最少；邻座 Chris 邀她与新同事吃泰国菜被她用谎话推掉。
facts.anchor: I work in accounts receivable, tracking payments, sending reminders for overdue invoices, and reconciling bank statements.

facts.fact: 她 27 岁，身上有自残疤痕：手腕竖线（自杀未遂）、大腿横线、肋骨烧伤；下次再失败她不想再进精神病房。
facts.anchor: Vertical lines across my wrists where I tried and failed. Horizontal lines along my thighs where I succeeded in a different kind of release.

facts.fact: 晚间仪式是泡茶和把玩水晶收藏（黑曜石球、紫水晶、拉长石、虎眼石等）——不为疗愈，只为「完美地无用」，这是她打工的全部理由。
facts.anchor: Mine serve no purpose beyond their existence. They are perfect in their uselessness.

facts.fact: 章末入睡时她又听见那声低语「Maven」，像祈祷又像承诺；黑暗把她拉进有「某人/某物」永远在等她的梦。
facts.anchor: My name, spoken like a prayer. A promise.
